integrity: A standalone exact search enumerated all size-26 independent sets, with independent arithmetic, orbit, pair-distance, and deletion-shadow checks. All necessary executable sources and output are included. No independent audit is represented.
limitations: Exact and independently reproducible finite-parameter classification for a five-symbol alphabet and five-element multisets only. Exhaustiveness uses a compiler-executed proper-coloring clique enumeration, not a symbolic closed-form classification in other parameters. The full text of arXiv:2607.13733 remained inaccessible during source comparison; equivalent prior material within it cannot be excluded. No downstream coding-rate improvement is asserted.
title: Six perfect maximum quinary length-five multiset deletion codes
